import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Initialize SPM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set to dynamic mode
opmode.Mode = "Dynamic"

# Set general parameters
zcontrol.SetPoint = 0.8  # 80% of free amplitude
zcontrol.PGain = 3100
zcontrol.IGain = 3500

# Define scan sizes (in meters)
sizes = [1e-6, 2e-6, 3e-6, 4e-6, 5e-6]  # This will give us areas of 1, 4, 9, 16, and 25 µm²

for size in sizes:
    # Set scan parameters
    scan.ImageWidth = size
    scan.ImageHeight = size
    scan.Points = 256
    scan.Lines = 256
    scan.Scantime = 1.0  # 1 second per line for good quality
    
    # Start scan
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    
    # Wait for scan completion (typical scan might take ~5 minutes)
    while scan.IsScanning:
        time.sleep(5)
    
    # Wait a bit more to ensure file is saved
    time.sleep(2)

del spm

# Start scan

import nanosurf
import time

# Initialize AFM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

head = application.ScanHead

# Set to contact mode (LateralForce mode is contact mode)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

    scan.ImageWidth = size
    scan.ImageHeight = size
    
    # Set filename
    application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(f"afm_experiment_level_4_trial_{i}")
    
    # Start scan
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    
    # Wait for scan completion
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
    while scanning:
        time.sleep(1)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
    
    print(f"Scan {i} completed")

del spm
print("All scans completed")

import nanosurf
import time

# Initialize SPM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set to contact mode with conservative parameters
zcontrol.PGain = 3100
zcontrol.IGain = 3500
zcontrol.SetPoint = 1

# Define scan areas (in meters)
scan_areas = [
    (2e-6, 2e-6),  # 2x2 µm
    (5e-6, 5e-6),  # 5x5 µm
    (10e-6, 10e-6), # 10x10 µm
    (15e-6, 15e-6), # 15x15 µm
    (20e-6, 20e-6)  # 20x20 µm
]

# Perform scans at different areas
for i, (width, height) in enumerate(scan_areas):
    scan.ImageWidth = width
    scan.ImageHeight = height
    scan.Points = 256
    scan.Lines = 256
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    time.sleep(scan.Scantime * scan.Lines * 1.1)  # Wait for scan completion with 10% buffer

del spm
